column1: # TypeScript definitions. Rule, in addition to JavaScript's (fixtures/langs/javascript):
#  - interfaces are interface, type aliases type_alias, enums and classes (abstract or not) class, methods method, class fields field;

#  - `export const/let/var x = value` is a constant (variable for let and var), whatever the type annotation; a constant that is not exported, or whose value is a call that builds nothing (`const built = build()`), is not a definition;
#  - `export const h = async () => {}` is a function; a component built by a wrapper (memo, forwardRef, lazy, styled) is a function; createContext(...) is a constant;
#  - CommonJS and prototype assignments are definitions under the same limits as JavaScript.
